notes: Fan-out/fan-in structure: the form submission drives three parallel AI question agents (one per declared part) whose outputs are merged, formatted to HTML, and emailed. Marks follow the frozen requirement (Part A 2, Part B 13, Part C 14); the native Part A prompt contains an internally inconsistent mark figure ('each worth 13 marks' alongside '2 marks each'), and the requirement's declared values take precedence per the evidence hierarchy. The native Gmail node sets a fixed BCC recipient; the frozen requirement declares only the CC/BCC option, so no fixed recipient was added to Gold.
